title: Parents: 3 questions before paying pilot training fees

phrases.say: Aapka bachcha pilot banna chahta hai?
phrases.caption: Aapka bachcha *pilot* banna chahta hai?

phrases.say: Fees dene se pehle, ye teen sawaal poochhiye.
phrases.caption: Fees se pehle *3 sawaal*

phrases.say: Ek: 12th mein Physics aur Maths hai?
phrases.caption: 1. 12th mein *Physics + Maths*?

phrases.say: Do: DGCA Class 2 medical clear hai?
phrases.caption: 2. *DGCA Class 2 medical* clear?

phrases.say: Teen: DGCA exams aur do sau ghante flying ka plan kya hai?
phrases.caption: 3. *DGCA exams + 200 ghante* ka plan?

phrases.say: Teeno ka jawab saaf ho, tabhi admission ki baat kariye.
phrases.caption: Pehle jawab, *phir admission*

phrases.say: We One Aviation pe free career counselling book kariye.
phrases.caption: *Free career counselling* book kariye

phrases.say: Bachche ka pura roadmap, bina kisi commitment ke.
phrases.caption: Pura roadmap, *no commitment*
